title: Utendi wa Tambuka
summary: Utendi wa Tambuka, also called the Book of Heraclius, is a Swahili epic poem dated 1728. Mwengo, son of Athumani, wrote it at the Sultan of Pate's palace on commission, recounting the deeds of Muhammad's first followers in wars with Byzantium. It is among the earliest known documents in Swahili.

uncertainty.note: Hamburg source says the 1728 dating of the oldest manuscript has been doubted by some scholars.

where.historical_name: Pate (sultan's palace at Yunga), Swahili coast

importance.justification: One of the earliest known documents in Swahili, a landmark of Swahili epic poetry.
